mapvote_endvote.description: Run the end-of-map vote automatically (SM sm_mapvote_endvote). sm_mapvote still works when this is off.

mapvote_start.description: Minutes before mp_timelimit runs out to start the vote (SM sm_mapvote_start). Never later than the vote duration plus 10 seconds, so the vote closes before the map ends.

mapvote_startround.description: Rounds before mp_maxrounds is reached to start the vote (SM sm_mapvote_startround). At least 1, so the vote closes before the last round ends.

mapvote_include.description: Maps on the ballot: nominations first, then random maplist.txt maps (SM sm_mapvote_include; capped at 8 with Extend, 9 without).

mapvote_exclude.description: Recently played maps left out of the random fill (SM sm_mapvote_exclude). Nominated maps are always listed.

mapvote_extend.description: How many times per map the vote offers Extend Map; 0 removes the option (SM sm_mapvote_extend).

extendmap_timestep.description: Minutes added to mp_timelimit when Extend wins (SM sm_extendmap_timestep).

extendmap_roundstep.description: Rounds added to mp_maxrounds when Extend wins (SM sm_extendmap_roundstep).

mapvote_voteduration.description: Seconds the vote stays open (SM sm_mapvote_voteduration).
